question_3_ehds_from_2029.answer: From 26 March 2029, for patient summaries and electronic prescriptions, EU residents get a right to download an electronic copy (Article 3(2)) and a right to request transmission to a healthcare provider in another Member State through MyHealth@EU (Article 7(2)). Recital 33 says such transmission can support continuity of care when people change their place of residence. This is a right on request, not an automatic transfer. Images, test results and discharge reports follow from 26 March 2031.
